summary: Restoration centres on 1.5 million ha of degraded land to be afforested or reforested by 2030, equal in area to 28.3% of current mapped forest and 1.8% of grassland. Other programmes cover 676,000 ha, 2 billion trees on 500,000 ha by 2026, 700,000 ha by 2030 and 107,100 ha in 2026–2035. Conservation includes protection of 800,000 ha of forest by 2035, sustainable management on 1.3 million ha by 2040, 12% protected natural territories and LULUCF net removals of 23 million tCO₂-eq/year by 2030 and 28 million by 2035. Agriculture targets 3% of arable land under organic farming by 2030, 76,000 ha converted annually in 2026–2030 and 1.5 million additional hectares under improved irrigation by 2035, equivalent to 2.37% of current mapped agriculture, plus resilient crops and livestock. Mixed actions seek Class II water quality in 35% of water bodies and LULUCF, forestry, agriculture and water investment.
